request:
Held-out assault-course lap. From the house, run out to the assault course and play a lap again, differently from last time where you can. Please include these moves on the climbable walls:
1. Climb a climbable wall all the way DOWN to the ground at its foot (hold Down until Lara steps off onto the floor).
2. While hanging on a climbable wall, press Jump to jump back off it.
3. Stand a step or two back from a climbable wall (not touching it), face it and jump straight up to grab it.
4. Running jump at a climbable wall, holding Action mid-air to grab it.
5. Grab a ledge from a jump, pull up, and shimmy along a ledge both ways.
Finish however you like (the zip-line is fine). Falls and mistakes are fine; just keep playing. In the note, list roughly which of 1-5 you managed.
